mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) within the next 6 months, or SPX posts negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with accelerating GDP.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to a hawkish Fed response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 4%, or core PCE inflation fails to exceed 3% YoY within the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation higher and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Headline CPI inflation fails to rise > 0.5% MoM in the month following the INDPRO drop, or SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances with a sharp INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4%, or real GDP growth remains above 2% YoY in the quarter following the rate hike.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% YoY, it signals a strong housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST growth exceeds 10% YoY, or existing home sales decline MoM in the month following the signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market that will slow consumer spending and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or initial jobless claims fail to rise > 10% over the same period.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) are both rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are rising, or real M2 money supply growth remains above 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales (RSAFS) decline by more than 5% YoY, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is also rising.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines > 5% YoY and UNRATE is rising, or consumer confidence rises > 5 points in the month following the signal.
